resources.string: Course 4 · Expert. 18 holes among lakes and quarries. Broad outside fairways provide a safe, considerably longer detour. Shortcuts use small isolated receptions: a wood 3 or controlled driver can save shots, provided you manage carry and rollout. Small greens then demand an accurate approach.

string-array.name: classic_vertigo_tips
string-array.item: Aim for the small reception about 198 m away with a wood 3 or controlled driver. It leaves about 187 m to the green. The broad detour skirts the entire basin; too much rollout from the reception finds water again.

Two isolated receptions: about 201 m from the tee, then 196 m between islets. Use a wood 3 or controlled driver for each; about 182 m then remain. The broad outside loop avoids the carries but needs more setup shots.
The small green lies about 157 m away beyond the lake: iron 5 or controlled hybrid. The broad opposite bank is an easier reception but leaves a long diagonal approach.
A wood 3 or controlled driver reaches the pocket about 206 m away between sand hazards. About 200 m remain. Stop on the pocket: merely flying over the quarry is not enough.
The isolated target lies about 190 m away and is only 18 m wide. Use a wood 3 or controlled driver; about 182 m remain. The broad route swings far around the opposite bank.
First reception about 204 m away, second carry about 202 m with a change of angle. A wood 3 or controlled driver can play both. About 197 m remain; outside terraces avoid the small targets.
Wood 5 or controlled wood 3 for the 187 m to the small green. Sand punishes a short shot. The broad opposite reception builds the hole with an extra approach.
The pocket beyond the sand lies about 205 m away: wood 3 or controlled driver. About 210 m remain. The broad outside fairway offers width with a much longer return to the green.
The peninsula about 202 m away offers only 18 m of width. Use a wood 3 or controlled driver; the approach is about 201 m. Water behind the reception demands rollout control.
The small reception about 192 m away leaves about 192 m to the green. Choose a wood 3 or control the driver. The broad cirque on the opposite bank adds setup shots.
The isolated balcony lies about 214 m away. A controlled wood 3 or reduced driver leaves about 214 m uphill. The outside fairway is broad, but its return to the green is very long.

The small green lies about 174 m away: hybrid or controlled wood 5. Water guards the front and side, with rear sand. The broad opposite bank allows a conservative reception followed by a diagonal approach.
The pocket between sand needles lies about 198 m away and is 18 m wide. Use a wood 3 or controlled driver; about 197 m remain. The broad detour skirts the entire quarry.
The isolated terrace lies about 210 m away: wood 3 or controlled driver. The green is about 203 m further uphill. The broad outside loop lets you set up without targeting the small terrace.
Two carries: about 212 m from the tee, then 211 m to the second reception. Wood 3 or controlled driver; about 209 m remain. The long outside crescent avoids the lakes with several setup shots.
About 199 m to the small green: wood 3 or controlled driver. The broad refuge on the opposite bank is easier to reach but requires a long approach. Read the preview to avoid rolling into rear sand.
The isolated tongue lies about 204 m away and is 18 m wide. Use a wood 3 or controlled driver; about 210 m remain. Water frames the reception while the outside fairway follows a broad dry loop.

First island about 195 m away, then a 202 m carry to the second. Wood 3 or controlled driver for both; about 192 m remain. The largest detour on the course stays broad and dry but is considerably longer.
